scenes.text: This tutorial covers Measure. Extract per-object intensity, morphology, texture, colocalization, and spatial features from segmented images.
Open Measure from the Core section. Select the project containing image stacks and masks produced by Mask.
In the main configuration area, use channel one, endoplasmic reticulum, as the channel of interest and choose the object types and feature families to measure.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. preview crops when needed, then process every selected field and object type.
When the workflow finishes, measurements dot db stores traceable single-object rows and optional image crops for annotation or classification.
